grid.title: Apuração Devolução Compra Matriz
grid.expression: SELECT TAB.NOTADEV ,TAB.DTENT ,TAB.PARCEIRO ,TAB.CODCFODEV ,TAB.NUNOTA ,TAB.NUMNOTA ,TAB.DTENTSAI ,TAB.CODCFO ,TAB.CODPROD ,TAB.DESCRPROD ,TAB.CODVOL ,TAB.QTDATENDIDA ,TAB.VLRCTB ,TAB.BASEATUAL ,TAB.ICMS ,TAB.PROPOR ,TAB.BASEATUAL * (TAB.PROPOR / 100) AS BASENOVA ,(TAB.BASEATUAL * (TAB.PROPOR / 100)) * (TAB.ALIQICMS / 100) AS ICMSNOVO ,TAB.ALIQICMS ,TAB.ICMS - ((TAB.BASEATUAL * (TAB.PROPOR / 100)) * (TAB.ALIQICMS / 100)) AS DIFERENCA FROM ( SELECT CAB1.NUMNOTA AS NOTADEV ,CAB1.DTENTSAI AS DTENT ,CAB1.CODPARC || ' - ' || (SELECT P.RAZAOSOCIAL FROM TGFPAR P WHERE P.CODPARC = CAB1.CODPARC) AS PARCEIRO ,(SELECT MAX(I.CODCFO) FROM TGFITE I WHERE I.NUNOTA = CAB1.NUNOTA) AS CODCFODEV ,CAB.NUNOTA ,LIV.SEQUENCIA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTENTSAI ,ITE.CODCFO ,ITE.CODPROD ,PRO.DESCRPROD ,ITE.CODVOL ,CASE WHEN LIV.ALIQICMS = 0 THEN ITE.AD_ALIQICMSSP ELSE LIV.ALIQICMS END AS ALIQICMS ,ITE.QTDNEG AS QTDATENDIDA ,LIV.VLRCTB ,CASE WHEN LIV.VLRICMS = 0 THEN ITE.AD_VLRICMSSP ELSE LIV.VLRICMS END AS ICMS ,CASE WHEN LIV.BASEICMS = 0 THEN ITE.AD_BASEICMSSP ELSE LIV.BASEICMS END AS BASEATUAL ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(CAB1.DTENTSAI, 'MM') <> :P_PERIODO.INI THEN ( SELECT MAX(I.ICMS) FROM AD_TGFPIM I WHERE I.ANO = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (CAB1.DTENTSAI)) AND I.MES = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CAB1.DTENTSAI)) ) ELSE 0 END AS PROPOR FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA RIGHT JOIN TGFCAB CAB1 ON CAB1.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTAORIG WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER = 305 AND CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 ) TAB ORDER BY TAB.NUNOTA, TAB.SEQUENCIA ASC
